title: IRL Activity Schema v0.1
description: An open, minimal data structure for real-world (offline) activities, designed so AI agents can query, compare and book them. Authored by CUQU (cuqu.net). CC BY 4.0.

schema_version.description: Schema identifier and version. Consumers MUST reject unknown major versions.

activity_id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the publishing platform. Opaque string; do not parse.

title.description: Human-readable title as published. May contain emoji.

activity_type.description: Canonical activity category. MUST be one of the standard terms; game/format names belong in keywords.

activity_type_en.description: Optional English equivalent of activity_type, for cross-locale consumers. Order matches the activity_type enum.

keywords.description: Free-form format/game tags (e.g. 剧本杀, 狼人杀, City Walk, 露营). NEVER put these in activity_type.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-09-25T19:00:00+08:00. Offset is REQUIRED for offline events.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 with UTC offset. Optional but strongly recommended.

time_text.description: Human-readable time as shown to users, e.g. '周六 19:00-22:00'. Useful when end_time is unknown.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name. Defaults to Asia/Shanghai for CN publishers.

city.description: City name as published, e.g. 深圳.

district.description: District / administrative area, e.g. 南山区.

venue.description: Physical venue. May be omitted for meetup-point style activities.

geo.description: WGS-84 coordinates. GCJ-02 (Amap/WeChat) coordinates MUST be converted before publishing.

amount.description: Per-person price in major currency units (yuan, not fen). MUST be 0 when free is true.

free.description: Explicitly marks a no-charge activity. MUST NOT be inferred from amount==0 alone.

includes.description: What the price covers, e.g. 含教学, 含装备, 饮品畅饮.

price.description: Strongly recommended. Omitting price is allowed but agents SHOULD treat it as unknown, not free.

min.description: Minimum participants for the activity to happen.

capacity.description: If both joined and max are present, remaining SHOULD equal max - joined.

tags.description: Audience/attribute tags, e.g. 新手友好, 含教学, 女生局.

status.description: Agents MUST NOT offer registration unless status == 'open'.

deep_link.description: App/mini-program path or scheme for direct jump. Opaque to consumers.

source.description: Provenance. Required for attribution; agents SHOULD echo it when citing an activity.
